async def act(page):
    # Click the first 'Byte Blaze' link to go to the user/group profile page.
    byte_blaze_links = page.get_by_role('link', name='Byte Blaze', exact=False)
    if await byte_blaze_links.count() > 0:
        await byte_blaze_links.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)  # Wait for navigation
    else:
        print('Byte Blaze link not found.')
        return
    # On the profile page, look for a 'Settings' link.
    settings_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Settings', exact=False)
    if await settings_link.count() == 0:
        settings_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Edit profile', exact=False)
    if await settings_link.count() > 0:
        await settings_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    else:
        print('Settings link not found.')
        return
    # In settings, look for 'Access Tokens' link.
    access_tokens_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Access Tokens', exact=False)
    if await access_tokens_link.count() > 0:
        await access_tokens_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    else:
        print('Access Tokens link not found.')
        return
    # On the access tokens page, retrieve the RSS feed token.
    # Look for a textbox or status element containing the token.
    token_element = page.get_by_role('textbox')
    if await token_element.count() == 0:
        token_element = page.get_by_role('status')
    if await token_element.count() > 0:
        # Get the token value without processing.
        if await token_element.get_attribute('value'):
            token = await token_element.input_value()
        else:
            token = await token_element.text_content()
        # Print the token as-is.
        print(token)
        return token
    else:
        print('No token element found.')
        return
